doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recording and working with Charles Mingus
summary: Young says he worked and recorded with Mingus, calls his music difficult, and recalls a big-band piece, perhaps Epitaph or the Town Hall concert.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Did you, you knew him, correct?

Yeah, I knew Charles Mingus. I worked with him quite a bit. I played with him, I did some recordings with him. Mingus had a group in New York, and I worked with that group for a little bit because I was very busy doing other things and I couldn‘t spend too much time with that group because, you know, you can‘t do too much, too many other things. And I was busy, but I worked with him as much as I could, Mingus, and I recorded with him. He and I was pretty good friends also.
What did you think of his music.
Oh, his music was something else. He was very difficult. He wrote some strange things you know.

I made a thing on him with a recording… oh I wish I could tell you the name of it, but the introduction I had a whole introduction and everything, and it turned out to be a pretty big thing, the introduction, and you don‘t have any idea what that is, do you? What tune or what?
No, was it something you recorded under your own name? Was it on Horn of Plenty?
No, it wasn‘t Horn of Plenty. No, it wasn‘t, Horn of Plenty was …
This was a thing of Mingus‘s. He wrote, he wrote a big band thing it was. And…
Oh, was that at the Carnegie Hall concert?
I wonder if that was the Carnegie Hall concert. Anyway.
Was it Epitaph? Epitaph? Was that the piece, the large piece?
That could be it. I don‘t…
Did Mingus conduct it or was it after Mingus died? This piece you‘re talking about, was it while Mingus was still alive?
Okay, okay, so it probably was… I‘m just trying to think, maybe the Town Hall concert?
Because I know Clark Terry was on the Town Hall Concert…

And then Clark did a song called Clark in the Dark. Wah, he used the mute, wah, it was a Mingus tune, it was a killer, yeah I think that was probably it. Yeah, and then also, Mingus yeah, I remember Reincarnation of a Lovebird had all that stuff from Charlie Parker in the beginning and then it would come into the tune.
